Distance constraint adapted from InteractiveComputerGraphics/PositionBasedDynamics, XPBD.cpp solve_DistanceConstraint. MIT. Revision 10a70bc146a97873dc3c8fef372f5217e010542e. Prisma uses equal masses and compliance with a unit pseudo-time step. Each phase is solved independently from periodic targets: guided elastic relaxation, not an inertial cloth simulation. Second-neighbour distance constraints resist bending; no port of the upstream isometric bending solver.

Motion correction: unilateral tension-only projection, non-positive multiplier and smooth tension onset. Compressed fibres no longer expand toward their rest length and buckle unpredictably. Second-neighbour links also resist stretching rather than forcing compressed bends open. No temporal filter or slowing of the timeline is used.
